$doc: The screen graph (backlog item 22). Every interactive element on a board of a wired page carries data-flow="n" (1..n per board, badges drawn by the shell); each number has exactly one edge here, whose `to` lists every outcome: a board, a declared terminal, or an explicit gap (a design still owed — honest, greppable, reported by check-flows.mjs and drawn on the generated maps). Repeated per-post elements are tagged on the first post instance only. `entries` declares how a screen is reached other than by a tap (app open, mail link, time); a screen on a wired page must be an entry or an edge target. `boardKinds` marks reference boards — vocabulary, not destinations.

terminals.back: Back — returns to the previous screen
terminals.self: Acts on this screen — state changes in place
